comment: KOTOR III (fan) Nar Shaddaa landing pad. Rhea Vex, a Mandalorian scout, joins the crew as navigator. Original writing for this fan project.

entries.text: You have been asking about me. The old woman or the Duros, I suppose. Either way, I am listening. Try to make it worth my time.
Not hiring, not buying, not curious. Keep walking.
Past the charts? I have spent a year stitching together the route the Exile flew, one rumour at a time. Where did your coordinates come from?
The clans. They sent me to learn where Revan went when he left, and whether any of us ought to follow. I am the scout, so here I am.
Then she got further than any of us guessed. All right, I will fly with you. But the clans hear everything I learn. That is my price, and it does not move.
You should not, yet. But you need someone who can read the old clan lanes, and I need to see where they end. Call it a fair trade.
Good. Now find us a ship that can survive the trip. Hesk Varo has one he has been trying to sell for months. I will tell you what it is really worth.

replies.text: I have coordinates past the charts, and I need a navigator.
Who sent you to Nar Shaddaa?
Then we want the same thing. I have coordinates past the charts.
From the Exile herself. A recording she sent home.
Why should I trust you with that?
Fair. They came from a recording the Exile sent home.
Your clans can have their share. Welcome to the crew.
